sharedContractNote: Fields here are Farside-local. Same shape as docs/azure/launch-checks.json. Do not invent dashmeta or AIF field names.
statusRule: An entry is unverified until a dated live run exists. Unverified entries are labelled not-supported. Live verification needs D7 and a GCP test project (E6-S1-T1).
rolesFromProposal: BigQuery access to the billing export
billingExportNote: GCP has no cost API. Spend and committed-use checks stay unassessed until the BigQuery billing export is enabled. The export fills only from that day forward, so the first day is empty.

checks.title: All assets by project and type
checks.dataSource: Cloud Asset Inventory search / list (name, assetType, location, project)

undetermined.when: Cloud Asset returns incomplete or forbidden results for a project
undetermined.closer: Grant Cloud Asset Viewer on that project and a successful asset list

checks.title: Resources with no owner label
checks.dataSource: Cloud Asset labels; owner label key is a Settings value

undetermined.when: The owner label key has not been configured for the org
undetermined.closer: Set the owner label key in Settings

undetermined.when: Labels are not returned for an asset type
undetermined.closer: A Cloud Asset row for that type that includes labels

checks.title: Unattached disks
checks.dataSource: Compute Engine disks where users is empty
checks.savingsBasis: Monthly list price of the unused disk type and size, as a range

undetermined.when: users is missing on a disk row
undetermined.closer: A disk read that includes the users list

checks.title: Reserved but unused external IPs
checks.dataSource: Compute Engine regional/global addresses where status is RESERVED and users is empty
checks.savingsBasis: Monthly list price of a reserved unused external IP, as a range

undetermined.when: status or users is missing on an address row
undetermined.closer: An address read that includes status and users

checks.title: Old snapshots and images
checks.dataSource: Compute Engine snapshots and custom images older than Settings snapshotRetentionDays
checks.savingsBasis: Monthly storage list price of the old snapshot or image, as a range

undetermined.closer: A snapshot or image read that includes creationTimestamp

checks.title: Idle VM and disk recommendations
checks.dataSource: Recommender idle VM and idle disk recommendations. Live run is leftover (#202).
checks.savingsBasis: Recommender savings range when present; otherwise undetermined, not a point value

undetermined.when: Recommender is not granted or returns no insights window
undetermined.closer: Grant Recommender Viewer and a recommendation list for that project

undetermined.when: A recommendation has no savings range
undetermined.closer: A recommendation primaryImpact with a min/max cost range

checks.title: Spend by service and project
checks.role: BigQuery access to the billing export
checks.dataSource: BigQuery billing export. There is no GCP cost API. History starts the day the export is enabled.

undetermined.when: The billing export dataset is missing or not granted
undetermined.closer: Enable the BigQuery billing export and grant the Farside workload read access

undetermined.when: The export has no completed day yet
undetermined.closer: At least one completed export day after enablement

checks.title: Committed-use discount use
checks.role: BigQuery access to the billing export
checks.dataSource: BigQuery billing export credits / CUD rows. Not a live purchase API.
checks.savingsBasis: Unused committed-use spend as a min/max range once utilization exists

undetermined.when: No CUD rows exist. None-found is not zero utilization
undetermined.closer: Export rows that name a committed-use discount, or an explicit none-found coverage cell

checks.title: Cloud SQL without high availability or backups
checks.dataSource: Cloud SQL instances availabilityType and backupConfiguration

undetermined.closer: A Cloud SQL instance read that includes both fields

checks.title: Out-of-support SQL and GKE versions
checks.dataSource: Cloud SQL databaseVersion and GKE currentMasterVersion from Cloud Asset or the SQL/GKE APIs. Support calendars are Farside-test data until a live announcement source exists.

undetermined.closer: An instance or cluster read that includes the engine version

undetermined.when: No support-end date is recorded for that version
undetermined.closer: A dated support calendar row for that version

checks.title: Expiring certificates
checks.dataSource: Certificate Manager certificates expireTime vs Settings certExpiryFlagDays

undetermined.closer: A Certificate Manager read that includes expireTime
